tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ྅mahān+dhimāyāshrān+tanābihāratisma/ /༄༅/ /rdzogs pa chen po sgyu ma ngal gso zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
྅mahān+dhimāyāshrān+tanābihāratisma/ /༄༅/ /rdzogs pa chen po sgyu ma ngal gso zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ྅ ma hā n+dhi mā yā shrā n+ta nā bi hā ra ti sma/ /༄༅/ /rdzogs pa chen po sgyu ma ngal gso zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

rgya gar skad du/ ma hā san+dhi mā yā bi shrān+ta nā ma/ bod skad du/ rdzogs pa chen po sgyu ma ngal gso zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kun ma skyes mnyam pa'i ngang nyid las/ /ye shes sgyu ma gnyis med rol pa che/ /sems nyid rgyal po rang byung gdod ma la/ /ma skyes 'du 'bral med pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal bas chos kun sgyu ma'i tshul gnyis su/ /yang dag gsung de rang bzhin rtogs bya'i phyir/ /mdo rgyud man ngag snying po'i bcud bsdus te/ /ji ltar nyams su myong bzhin bshad kyis nyon/ /gzhi dbyings mi 'gyur sems nyid nam mkha' che/ /stong gsal spros dang bral ba'i ngang nyid las/ /rgyal chos dri med nyi zla gza' skar bzhin/ /lhun grub sku gsum ye shes 'du 'bral med/ /ngang gis 'od gsal yon tan rdzogs par ldan/ /'di ni rang bzhin gdod ma'i gnas lugs te/ /yang dag gzhi yi sgyu ma lags par gsungs/ /de nyid ngang las glo bur 'khrul ba'i sprin/ /rmi lam byed po gnyid kyi ngang tshul can/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig nyid dang ni/ /gnyis med gnyis su 'dzin pas bslad pa'i sems/ /kun tu brtags pa'i ma rig las byung bas/ /'gro drug 'khrul snang sna tshogs rmi lam bzhin/ /med bzhin snang la bde sdug so sor myong*/ /yun ring dus nas goms pa 'di dag kun/ /gnas dang lus dang longs spyod la sogs pa/ /rang snang dge sdig las gyur bde sdug bsngal/ /rnam pa sna tshogs ri mor bris 'dra ba/ /gcig nyid 'khrul las mang por snang gyur te/ /du mar bzung las 'khrul snang rgyun mi 'chad/ /e ma srid pa'i rang bzhin rmi lam bzhin/ /rang byung sems nyid gcig gi ngo bo la/ /ma rig gnyid kyi 'khrul snang gzung 'dzin blo/ /sna tshogs mang ldan rmi lam snang ba 'di/ /rang sems nyid las gzhan du ci yang med/ /log rtog sgyu ma nyid ces rgyal bas gsungs/ /ji ltar da du ra yis myos pa las/

/snang ba sna tshogs snang yang 'khrul par gcig /de bzhin ma rig gnyid myos las byung ba'i/ /'gro drug sems 'khrul ba la snang ba 'di/ /bden pa med ces de ring rtogs par bya/ /'khrul snang 'khrul 'dzin 'khrul rtog las byung bas/ /bden med rdzun med gnyis med blo 'das ces/ /nges par rang rig rang byung shes bya ste/ /yin min yod min mtha' grol klong yangs su/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mkha' ltar shes par bya/ /chos kun rang bzhin rmi lam lta bu ste/ /snang dus nyid nas ngo bo 'ga' med la/ /rnam pa ma dor snang ba ma 'gags shing*/ /re zhig rdzun la rnam kun stong pa'i gzugs/ /shin tu dpyad na bden min rdzun pa min/ /yod min med min rang bzhin mtha' las 'das/ /mkha' mnyam brjod 'das bsam yul rnams dang bral/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag par shes par bya/ /de ltar snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /rmi lam dang 'drar lta bas thag bcad nas/ /sgom pas nyams su blang phyir bstan pa ni/ /bde ba'i gdan la skyil dkrung rab bcas nas/ /skyabs su 'gro dang byang chub sems bskyed de/ /chos kun mnyam rdzogs stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /stong pa'i sgyu ma rab tu bsgom par bya/ /spyi bor pad zla nyi ma'i dbus nyid du/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gror bcas/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma dbyer med gsal btab la/ /mchod bstod rmi lam 'byong bar gsol ba gdab/ /bdag dang snang srid 'od zhu bla mar thim/ /mkha' mnyam ngang der dar cig glod la bsgom/ /de yis byin rlobs rtogs pa shugs las 'char/ /de nas dngos gzhi ji ltar bsgom pa ni/ /phyi rol ri dang lung pa yul gru dang*/ /sa chu me rlung nam mkha' sems can sogs/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg ste yul lnga dang*/ /nang gi lus dang dbang shes chos rnams kun/ /rmi lam nyid ces yang dang yang bsgom zhing*/ kha rtsang phan chad 'das pa'i chos rnams kun/ /mdang sum rmi lam dang 'drar yid kyi yul/

/de ring snang ba'ang med snang 'khrul pa'i blo/ /mdang dang do nub rmi lam dang 'dra zhing*/ / sang dang sang nub ma 'ongs rmi lam ste/ /dgag sgrub bde sdug cir snang thams cad la/ /rmi lam yin pa'i 'du shes nyer bzhag nas/ /bden pa'i blo ni skad cig bsgom mi bya/ /'gro 'dug za 'chag gtam smrar gyur pa na'ang*/ /rmi lam nang zhes ma yengs dran pas gzung*/ ci snang ci byed ci bsam thams cad kun/ /rmi lam yin pa'i 'du shes ma bral pas/ /bden med 'al 'ol ban bun phyad phyod dang*/ /sang seng khral khrol 'dzin med chen por sbyang*/ /gzung yul 'khrul snang rmi lam nyid brtags pas/ /gzung ba'i blo bral 'dzin pa shugs la phral/ /yul bkag pas ni yul can 'gog pa yin/ /res 'ga' snang ba rmi lam nyid 'jal ba'i/ /sems de phyi nang bar gsum rab btsal bas/ /ngo bo ngos gzung gza' gtad med pa'i blo/ / phyogs 'byams nam mkha' 'dra ba'i ngang nyid du/ /dran bsam tshol khro bral ba'i rig pa de/ /stong gsal spros dang bral ba ngang gis 'char/ /'dzin pa 'gags pas gzung ba rang 'gags pa/ /yul can log pas yul 'dzin grol ba'i tshe/ /snang yul 'brel med dpyad ra zhig par snang*/ /de tshe gnyis med rang byung ye shes yin/ /de ltar rtogs shing goms pa'i rang dus na/ / gzung 'dzin log pas yul sems zhen pa grol/ /snang la dair 'dzin med pa'i nyams shar bas/ /gang snang ye stong rtsa ba bral bar 'char/ /'di ni rang bzhin gdod ma'i gnas lugs yin/ /rim gyis snang yul ma dag gzhan dbang yang*/ /der 'dzin log pas dag pa gzhan dbang du/ /ji zhig tshe na mngon du gyur pa yin/ /rmi lam 'phrul snang gnyid sad med pa bzhin/ / gdod ma'i gzhi lam mngon par byang chub 'gyur/ /'khrul pa'ang sngon med phyis med bar 'dir snang*/ /snang yang snang ba'i dus na yod ma myong*/ /med bzhin snang ba bag chags 'khrul ba'i blo/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag pas rmi lam 'dra/

/ji ltar rmi lam nang gi snang ba de/ /gnyid ma song dang sad dus med na yang*/ /gnyid dus snang la snang dus rang bzhin med/ /med snang gzhi rtsa bral bar shes par bya/ /de ltar nyin mo rab tu goms bya zhing*/ / mtshan mo gnyid kyis rab tu snyoms pa'i tshe/ /bde ba'i mal du g.yas phab nyal ba ni/ /mgon po mya ngan 'das gzims lta bu la/ /rlung rgyu rab tu dal dang mig mi 'gul/ /snying nang a dkar shel gong 'od 'bar ba/ /tshon gang ches phra'i ngang la sems bzung la/ /rmi lam lta bu'i dran pas ma yengs bya/ /de yis rmi lam lta bu'i 'od gsal 'char/ /thog mar rmi lam 'jigs dngangs rmis pa na/ /rmi lam dran pas 'jigs pa rang sar grol/ /rmi lam ngang der ting 'dzin grub pa ni/ /rmi lam zin zhes rnal 'byor pas shes bya/ /de nas rmi lam bden med gcig tu sbyong*/ /de yang med bzhin snang 'di 'khrul pa'i blo/ /rmi lam dang 'dra ngo bo ngos gzung med/ /bden rdzun blo las 'das pa shes par bya'o/ /de nas sprul zhing bsgyur ba'i rim pa yang*/ /rmi lam dus der rang lus tshangs pa lhar/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems sogs gang 'dod du/ /sprul zhing bsgoms la bden med ngang du gzhag /de nas skad cig skad cig tsam nyid du/ /tshangs las brgya byin de bzhin lha las mi/ /gang 'dod bsgyur la bden med ngang du bsgom/ /de nas brgya stong byai bar spel bya zhing*/ /gang 'dul thabs kyis gnyen por rtsal sbyang ngo*/ /de nas dag pa'i zhing dang yul khams dang*/ /'og min la sogs gang 'dod der song ste/ /bde gshegs blta dang gtsang ma'i chos nyan dang*/ /ye shes ting 'dzin gzungs sprin bsgrub pa yang*/ /nyin mtshan kun tu dran pas rab sbyangs pas/ /de ltar 'gyur ba rig pa'i yon tan te/ /gnad las mi bslu mngon du byed pa yin/ /'di ni yang zab snying po'i theg pa 'o/ /de ltar nyin mtshan rmi lam don bsgoms pas/ /dngos po mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i gzeb las grol/

/ra ba ri dang rtsig par thogs med cing*/ /rdzu 'phrul mngon shes ting 'dzin grangs med 'grub/ /nyams rtogs tshad med 'phags pa'i ye shes skye/ /mthar thug sems nyid gdod ma'i dbyings phyin nas/ /rang don chos sku gzhan don gzugs sku gnyis/ /rmi lam lta bur don gnyis lhun gyis grub/ /de phyir rmi lam lta bu'i tshul sgoms shig /rdzogs pa chen po sgyu ma ngal gso las/ /rmi lam lta bu'i le'u ste dang po'o// // yang 'dir rgyal bas sgyu ma lta bu zhes/ /chos rnams rang bzhin med pa'i tshul gsungs pa/ /de yang mdo rgyud man ngag snying po'i don/ /ji ltar nyams su myong bzhin bshad kyis nyon/ /sems nyid gdod ma nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang*/ /lhun grub ye shes nyi zla gza' skar bzhin/ /ye 'byams rmad du byung ba'i dbyings rum las/ /ma rig gzung 'dzin kun brtags rang shar bas/ khams gsum 'gro drug 'khrul snang sgyu ma bzhin/ /rgyu rkyen rten 'brel stobs kyis rang snang ba/ /shing bu rde 'u rig sngags tshogs pa las/ /mig 'phrul rta glang skyes pa bud med dang*/ /ri dang khang bzang la sogs snang ba bzhin/ /ma rigs dbang gis bag chags 'khrul pa'i blo/ /snang srid yul dang der 'dzin dug gsum shar/ /rang bzhin med la snang ba ma 'gags pa/ /sgyu ma'i skye bo 'dra ba 'di dag kun/ /bden med stong pa'i gzugs brnyan chen po ru/ /de ring nyid du nges par rtogs par bya/ /yong ye snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /rang bzhin gshes la mkha' 'dra mnyam pa nyid/ /ma skyes gdod nas dag pa shes par bya/ /skye med skye ba'i cho 'phrul ngang nyid du/ / rang bzhin sgyu ma sbyang bya'i gzhi dang ni/ /ma dag sgyu ma sbyang bya'i dri ma dang*/ / thabs kyi sgyu ma sbyong byed gnyen po dang*/ /ye shes sgyu ma mthar phyin 'bras bu ste/ /rnam bzhi dpe yi sgyu mas gtan la phab/ /ji ltar rig sngags las byung mig 'phrul te/

/shing bu rde'u rta glang snang dus nas/ /rta glang ma yin shing bu rde'u nyid/ /de bzhin chos kun bden med mtshon pa nyid/ /rang bzhin dpe yi sgyu mar shes bya ste/ /'khrul pa'i gzhi dang 'khrul rkyen 'khrul pa'i tshul/ / 'khrul snang 'khrul grol gdod mar grol tshul rnams/ /dpe yi sngon rol dpe dang dpe 'grub dang*/ /dper grub dpe zhig sngon bzhin rang mtshan dus/ / rnam bzhi go rims dpe yi sgyu mas bstan/ /rang bzhin sgyu ma sems nyid 'od gsal te/ /sbyang gzhi'i dbyings yin bde gshegs snying po yin/ /dag dang ma dag gang du'ang ma chad pas/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa gnyis las 'das/ /'khor 'das 'byung ba'i dbyings yin 'char gzhi yin/ /rig dang ma rig rkyen las de ltar yin/ /'di ni gdod ma'i gshis yin gnas lugs yin/ /me long dngas bzhin gzugs brnyan 'char gzhi byed/ /shar dus nyid nas gang du'ang ma chad pas/ /me long dngos de dkar nag gnyis med la/ /dkar nag gnyis ka'i 'char gzhi byed dang mtshungs/ /'di nyid shes pas kun la mkhas par 'gyur/ /ma dag sgyu ma 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang de/ /gnyis med gnyis su bzung las der snang ngo*/ /thabs kyi sgyu ma gnyen po'i lam yin te/ /tshogs dang sbyor mthong sgom pa'i lam bzhi ru/ /tshogs gnyis rim gnyis sbyong byed bsgoms pa yis/ /sbyang bya'i dri ma sprin 'dra sel byed yin/ /ye shes sgyu ma mthar phyin mi slob lam/ /rgyal ba'i sku gsum 'phrin las lhun grub ste/ /dag pa gnyis ldan mngon du gyur pa yin/ /dpe yi sgyu ma rten 'brel sgyu ma ste/ /rdzas sngags dag las snang ba'i gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /bden med nyid du chos kun gtan la phebs/ /'di dag sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i tshul las yin/ /ji ltar rdzas dang rig sngags 'dus pa las/ /gzhan du snang na 'khrul par shes par bya/ /'gro ba'i 'khrul snang don la med pa ste/ /bag chags 'khrul pa'i rten 'brel snang ba tsam/

/ snang dus nyid nas stong la ngos gzung med/ /yod med mtha' las 'das pa shes par bya/ /sgyu ma'i yul dang sgyu ma'i grong khyer dang*/ /sgyu ma'i skye bo sgyu ma'i longs spyod dang*/ /sgyu ma'i bde sdug sgyu ma'i skye 'jig dang*/ /sgyu ma'i bden rdzun ji ltar snang ba ltar/ /'gro drug snang ba de ltar shes par bya/ /gdod nas dag pas sgyu ma lta bu la/ /med bzhin snang bas sgyu ma nyid dang mtshungs/ /rkyen las skyes phyir sgyu ma dang 'dra zhing*/ /bslu zhing 'jigs pa sgyu ma lta bu zhes/ /'khor ba'i 'khrul snang sgyu mar gtan la phab/ /'di ltar 'gro drug sgyu ma'i rang bzhin du/ /don la gnas kyang de ltar ma rtogs pas/ /mtha' med 'khor ba'i grong 'dir rgyun du 'khyams/ /bde sdug las kyis mnar bas snying re rje/ /'khrul snang sgyu mar soms shig skye bo dag / gang nas ma byung gang du ma song zhing*/ /gar yang mi gnas chos kun chos nyid ngang*/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i sgyu ma ru/ /skal ldan rnams kyi lta bas thag chod cig /sems can rang bzhin sgyu ma lta bu la/ /byang chub rang bzhin sgyu ma'i ngang nyid do/ /'khor 'das gnyis med sgyu ma'i rol pa ru/ /skal bzang rnams kyis de ltar shes par bya/ /rgyal bas chos tshul sgyu ma nyid las gzhan/ /rdul tsam dmigs su med ces gsungs pa bzhin/ /gang snang bden med sgyu ma'i chos nyid du/ /thar pa 'dod pa dag gis shes par bya/ / sgyu ma'i tshul yang 'di ltar rig par bya/ /byang chub sgyu ma lhun grub 'pho 'gyur med/ /mi bslu khyab bdag rtag tu nam mkha' dang*/ /nyi bzhin nor bu ltar bur re ba skong*/ /mtha' yas yon tan phrin las rdzogs par rol/ /dag gsal spros dang bral ba'i rang bzhin no/ /'khor ba'i sgyu ma mi bden bslu ba ste/ /mtshan nyid chad la med snang sgyu ma bzhin/ /'khrul rtog nub tshe 'khrul snang dbyings su nub/ /rigs sngags gshis las rta glang mi snang bzhin/

/ma dag snang yul gzung 'dzin gdod mar grol/ /dag pas stong la ngo bo med pa bzhin/ /gshis kyi sgyu ma chos nyid 'pho 'gyur med/ /dag dang ma dag kun gyi chos nyis de/ /rdza snod gser snod nang gi mkha' dbyings bzhin/ /snod dang snod chag rkyen gyis 'phel 'grib med/ /de bzhin 'khrul dang grol ba'i rang dus kyi/ /chos nyid 'phel 'grib bzang ngan med par gnas/ /'di ni gnas lugs don gyi dgongs pa yin/ /de ltar shes na skye bo mkhas pa yin/ /gang tshe sgyu ma'i lta ba rtogs rjes su/ /sgyu ma'i bsgom pa bden med chen po ni/ /sngon 'gro sngar bzhin sgyu mar gsol ba btab/ /dngos gzhi phyi nang sna tshogs chos 'di rnams/ /rgyu rkyen dbang gis sgyu mar snang ba ste/ /don la mi bden 'al 'ol zang thal du/ /skad cig skad cig nyin mtshan rtag par bsgom/ /chags sdang dgag sgrub nyon mongs ci shar yang*/ /sgyu ma nyid ces bden pa med pa sbyong*/ /phyi rol dngos kun sgyu ma nyid dang ni/ /nang gi kun rtogs sgyu ma lta bu ste/ /rkyen las skyes phyir mi bden bslu ba'i phyir/ /snang tsam nyid phyir sgyu ma'i dpe bsgom mo/ /nyal tshe'ang sngar bzhin khyad par sgyu ma'i ngang*/ /bden med spros dang bral bar lhod kyis glod/ /de nas 'khrul pa'i rmi lam ci shar yang*/ /sgyu mar shes pas bden zhen 'jigs dngangs grol/ /sgyu mar sbyong dang spel bsgyur dag pa'i zhing*/ /sgyu ma lta bur bgrod tshul sngar bzhin no/ /des ni 'khor ba'i zhen 'dzin rang grol te/ /sgyu mar grol nas mi gnas mya ngan 'das/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i don gnyis lhun gyis grub/ /de phyir sgyu ma lta bu'i don bsgoms shig /rdzogs pa chen po sgyu ma ngal gsol las/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// // yang 'dir rgyal bas mig yor lta bu zhes/ /gsungs pa gang de legs par bshad kyis nyon/ /ji ltar gzugs las mig yor snang ba bzhin/

/ sems nyid ngang las bag chags 'khrul ba'i mthus/ /'khor ba'i mig yor med snang 'khrul pa grub/ /gang ltar snang ba de ltar mig yor bzhin/ /mi mkhas bden par zhen pa'i byis pa bslus/ /yul lnga'i mig yor gzeb tu bcings pa na/ /don med bdag tu bzung bas 'khrul la ltos/ /snang srid snod bcud bde sdug mtho dman rnams/ /med bzhin snang ba mar me'i grib ma dang*/ /mig btsir ba las gzugs brnyan gnyis pa dang*/ /nyon mongs tshogs mang mtshan mo'i mun pa bzhin/ /ma brtags snang la brtags na ngos gzung med/ /shin tu brtags na rang bzhin mtha' las 'das/ /mkha' 'dra ma skyes gdod ma'i chos nyid du/ /de ring nyid nas nges par rtogs par gyis/ /'khrul snang gzhi med mig yor lta bu ste/ /rtsa ba bral zhing mtshan nyid kun tu chad/ /brtags pas stong la med bzhin snang ba ste/ /rang bzhin ma skyes gdod mar rtogs par bya/ /ji ltar thag ring mya ngam thang dkyil na/ / chung ngu'ang chen por snang ba nyid bzhin du/ /bdag med bdag tu 'dzin pa chung ngu las/ /'khor ba'i 'khrul snang chen por 'di dag snang*/ /'khrul par snang 'di brtags na dngos med do/ /mkha' bzhin byed po med par mngon pas na/ /med snang mig yor lta bu'i srid pa la/ /don med bdag tu ma 'dzin ji bzhin zhog /ngang yin ye yin gdod nas dag pa yin/ /gang yang ma 'dzin cir yang ma rtogs shig /ngo bo ngos gzung med pa'i snang ba la/ / phyogs 'dzin zhen pa'i gzeb kyis ci byar yod/ /de bas ched du dmigs pa kun btang ste/ /gang snang bden pas stong par shes par bya/ /de ltar chos rnams mig yor ltar rtogs nas/ /de nyid don la ji bzhin blo gzhag bya/ / sngon 'gro sngar bzhin mig yor gsol ba gdab/ /dngos gzhi chos kun mig yor ltar bsgoms te/ /gzugs ni bden pas stong ste mig yor 'dra/ /sgra ni grags pas stong ste mig yor bzhin/ /dri ro reg kyang mig yor dang 'dra zhing*/

/yid dang chos kyang mig yor lta bu ste/ /gang yang bden pa med pa'i ngang nyid du/ /blo yang zhen 'dzin med par glod la gzhag /nyin bzhin mnal tshe'ang snying gar sems bzung la/ /chos kun mig yor 'dra ba'i ngang der nyal/ /rmi lam zin sogs sngar bzhin nges pa 'char/ /nyams rtags snang ba'ang rmi lam lta bu ste/ /gang la'ang bden med rtogs pa shugs las 'byung*/ /'dzin med zang ka dgag sgrub 'khrul pa 'jig /spyan dang mngon shes ting 'dzin yon tan 'grub/ /rgyal ba'i chos mdzod 'gro kun 'dren pa yin/ /de phyir mig yor lta bu'i don sgom shig /rdzogs pa chen po sgyu ma ngal gso las/ /mig yor lta bu'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// // yang 'dir rgyal bas smig rgyu lta bu zhes/ /gsungs pa de yang ji bzhin bshad kyis nyon/ /ji ltar sos ka'i nyi ma phyed dus na/ /thang rnams smig rgyu chu yi phung po bzhin/ /sems la bdag 'dzin shin tu goms pa'i mthus/ / sprul pa'i 'khrul snang smig rgyu lta bur snang*/ /'di la ngo bo ngos gzung 'ga' med de/ /rang bzhin gnyis med stong pa zhi ba'i chos/ /ma skyes nam mkha' 'dra zhing bdag med la/ /skye med bsam yul 'das pa shes par bya/ /ji ltar snang 'di snang ba'i dus nyid nas/ /skye bar snang yang ma skyes smig rgyu ltar/ /gnas par snang yang mi gnas smig rgyu 'dra/ /'gags par snang yang ma 'gags smig rgyu bzhin/ /snang la rang bzhin med par shes par bya/ / dga' dang mi dga' bde sdug bzang ngan kun/ /smig rgyu 'dra zhing stong la bdag med de/ /phyi nang snang srid chos kun smig rgyu 'dra/ /med bzhin snang la rang bzhin gdod nas dag /ye stong mtha' dbus med ces rtogs par bya/ / gnyis med gnyis su 'dzin pa smig rgyu bzhin/ /don med dgag sgrub zhen pas ma bcings par/ /rang sems gnyis med smig rgyu lta bur ltos/ /'di ni dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa yin/

/de nas ji ltar bsgom pa'i rim pa yang*/ /sngon 'gro sngar bzhin smig rgyu'i gsol ba gdab/ /dngos gzhi chos kun smig rgyu lta bu'i ngang*/ /sems kyi 'byung 'jug re dogs bral bar gzhag /mtshan mo'ang sngar bzhin rtags rnams smig rgyur 'char/ /gang la'ang mi zhen bdag 'dzin ngang gis grol/ /gzungs sprin mngon shes ting 'dzin khong nas 'char/ /rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur du 'grub pas na/ /rang bzhin smig rgyu lta bu'i don sgoms shig /rdzogs pa chen po sgyu ma ngal gso las/ /smig rgyu lta bu'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// // yang 'dir rgyal bas chu zla lta bu zhes/ /ji skad gsungs de nyams su blang phy-ir bshad/ /sems nyid zab cing dngas pa'i mtsho dbus su/ /lhun grub gzugs brnyan ye shar gnas mod kyang/ /gzung 'dzin rba rlabs rnyog pa'i dri ma yis/ /gsal bar ma gyur rtog pa'i rlung gis dkrugs/ /'jig rten rmongs pa bdag 'dzin las byung bas/ /ye shes mi gsal mi shes nyon mongs can/ /thog mthar dus med 'khor bar bying gyur te/ /ji ltar chu gtsang nang gi gza' skar gzugs/ /dngas la mi g.yo med bzhin snang ba ltar/ /'khrul snang gzugs brnyan sems chur shar ba'i gzugs/ /med bzhin snang bas 'gro kun nyam re thag /'d-i ci dngos por ma yin ngos gzung med/ /mtshan mar ma yin mtshan ma med ma yin/ /yod med ma yin bden rdzun mtha' las 'das/ /gzugs brnyan nyid ces gsungs de thog tu babs/ /gzugs sogs yul drug chu zla dang 'dra ste/ /med la snang phyir ngo bo ma grub phyir/ /rnam pa ma 'gags 'khrul ngor snang ba'i phyir/ /mig dang mig dbang mig shes la sogs drug /chu zla 'dra zhing stong la gsog dang gsob/ /ya ma brla 'dra chu shing dngos po med/ rnam kun bden pas stong zhes rtogs par bya/ /mtha' yis ma gos dri ma med pa'i sems/ /chu zla'i tshul te snang stong spros dang bral/ /zab zhi mi rtog ye shes brjod las

'das/ /rang gsal ngang las mi g.yo shes par bya/ /chu zlar snang dus zla ba ma grub ltar/ /sna tshogs snang dus sna tshogs grub bsal med/ /dus gsum tha snyad btags pa'i blo dang bral/ /mi rtog ji bzhin nyid du gnas de zhog /ma lus 'gro 'ong med pa'i byang chub sems/ /phyi dang nang med bsam 'das ris ma 'dzin/ /rgya chad phyogs lhung med pa'i chos nyid la/ /yangs dog mtho dman med kyis tshol khro zhog /ma bsam gcig du mi gnas gdod ma'i ngang*/ /gang yin kun yin chu zla lta bu yin/ /bden min rdzun min 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid/ /ji bzhin chos nyid ngang du sems pa zhog /snang srid 'khor 'das chu zla stong pa'i gzugs/ /ye stong babs stong rangabazhin gzod nas stong*/ /de la yod med blos btags 'khrul pas na/ /tha dad phyogs ris grub mtha' ma zhen kye/ /ji srid ngar 'dzin zhen pa'i blau yod pa/ / ji srid 'khor ba nyid de thar dus med/ /'dzin med rang babs so gnyug rnal ma'i sems/ /zang ka ye babs rang grol phyogs yin ni/ /rang bzhin nyid de de la bcos ci dgos/ /yul rnams ngos stong chu zla lta bu la/ /blo yang zhen stong 'dzin med shar ba na/ /gzunga'adzin gnyis med yul sems 'brel med pas/ ji bzhin rtsol bral rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang*/ /gang byung grogs su 'char ba'i rang bzhin la/ /phyogs med bde ba chen por lhun gyis grub/ de ltar shes de bgrod pa'i sa med par/ /gdod ma'i gzhi la mngon par byang chub 'gyur/ /de ltar rtogs nas ngang der gnas pa ni/ /mi g.yo chu zla lta bu'i sgom pa de/ /cir snang bden med 'al 'ol phyam phyam du/ /skal bzang skye bos rab tu goms par bya/ sngon 'gro sngar bzhin chu zlar gsol btab la/ / dngos gzhi gang snang dngos de chu zla dang/ /'dra ba nyid du bsams la mnyam par gzhag /mtshan dus sngar bzhin khyad par chu zla'i nyams/ /gang la'ang 'dzin med phyam gcig ngang du gnas/

/myur du sems nyid rgyal po'i gtan srid zin/ /gang snang bltas pas der snang 'dzin pa bral/ /dngas gsal chu zla lta bu'i 'od gsal 'char/ /'di ni skal mchog ldan pas rab sgoms shig /rdzogs pa chen po sgyu ma ngal gso las/ /chu zla lta bu'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// // yang 'di rgyal bas brag ca lta bu zhes/ /gsungs pa de yang gsal bar bshad kyis nyon/ /ji ltar brag ri'i drung 'dug mi dag gis/ /ji snyed brjod bzhin brag ca'i dbyangs 'byung ba/ /de bzhin chos kun rkyen 'byung ngo bo med/ /bden pas stong zhes nges par rtogs par bya/ /brag ca grags dus phyi nang bar rnams su/ /brag ca'i dbyangs de btsal yang mi rnyed ltar/ /phyi nang chos kun blo yis dpyad byas na/ /sems dang sems la snang ba'i chos rnams kun/ /rags phra'i rnam pa tsam yang mi rnyed de/ /mkha' bzhin stong la dngos med rnam par dag /de ltar rtogs na gang la'ang zhen 'dzin med/ /kun rdzob snang la don dam mi dmigs zhes/ /cha gnyis 'dzin pa'ang blo yi rnam dbye ste/ /ji ltar snang dus nyid nas blo las 'das/ /blos bkod spros pa'i dra ba rang sems te/ /yul der 'phel 'grib gang du'ang mi byed pas/ /rtog pa'i dra bas ma 'dzin ngos gzung med/ /de ltar shes te spros pa'i pha rol 'gro /gdod ma'i sems nyid nam mkha' yid bzhin dang*/ /yon tan lhun grub rgya mtsho dri med las/ /kun rtog ma rig rkyen byung srid pa'i chos/ /med snang brag ca lta bur 'dir 'khyams te/ /'gro drug rang snang bag chags dbang gis snang/ /rnyog pa'i rang sems rab 'jug dbang gis 'jug /de lta na yang 'gro sems 'khrul snang 'di/ /gzhi med rtsa ba bral ba'i rang bzhin no/ /e ma med bzhin snang 'di dgod re bro/ /don med ngang la don du gzung ba yis/ /don 'di snang ba brag cha'i dbyangs 'dra ba*/ /'di la bden zhen 'dzin pa ci zhig bya/ /gang yin gtad med phyam gcig ngang der zhog

/'phral byung snang ba bden med chen por grol/ /yangs dog mtho dman med pas nyams re dga'/ /gang byung ched 'dzin zhig pa'i snang ba la/ /dgag sgrub brag ca 'dra ba'i snang ba shar/ /ci yin gza' gtad med par grol bas na/ /de yin phyogs cha bral bar phyam gcig zhog /ha ha ltos dang 'khrul snang dgod re bro/ /ngo bo ngos gzung med la khral ma khrol/ /zab zob 'al 'ol yal yol ban ma bun/ /phyad phyod bden zhen med la sna tshogs snang/ /mi mkhas bden par zhen la bden bden 'dra/ /bden med rnal 'byor pa la phyam phyam gcig /mi rtag rtag par 'dzin la rtag rtag 'dra/ /rtag 'dzin ngang gis grol la stongs gzugs gcig /yangs dog rgya chad med la nyams dga'o/ /rtog pa'i don la goms 'dris bya ba ni/ /sngon 'gro sngar bzhin brag car gsol ba gdab/ /dngos gzhi chos kun sgra brnyan brag ca 'dra/ /grags dus nyid nas ngos gzung med pa ltar/ /cir snang thams cad de bzhin bsgoms par bya/ khyad par bstod smad snyan dang mi snyan kun/ /grags pas stong la ngo bo ngos gzung med/ /de la sems kyi dgag sgrub don med kyi/ /sgra rnams brag ca 'dra bar rtogs par bgyi'o/ khro sogs sems de yul dang phyogs na med/ /med la snang dus btsal yang rnyed pa med/ /rkyen byung stong pa brag ca'i dbyangs 'dra zhing/ /pha rol tshig kyang rkyen byung grag pa 'dra/ /dpyad la med na snang ba'i gzugs brnyan tsam/ /shin tu btags na mkha' bzhin dngos med cing/ /legs nyes shor god ci yang mi dmigs pas/ /sgra la don du ma 'dzin bden pas stong*/ /rnam kun brag ca 'dra ba rtogs par gyis/ /de yis thog med 'khor ba'i bag chags dang*/ khyad par khong khro zhe sdang mi 'jil zhing/ /'phags pa'i bzod thob ngan song yang mi ltung*/ /rim gyis rgyal ba'i 'byor pa nye bar skye/ /mtshan mo'ang sngar bzhin khyad par brag ca'i nyams/ /grag pa sgras stong chos la bzod pa thob/

/de phyir brag ca lta bu'i don bsgoms shig /rdzogs pa chen po sgyu ma ngal gso las/ /brag ca lta bu'i le'u ste drug pa'o// // yang 'dir rgyal bas dri za'i grong khyer zhes/ /gsungs pa de yang bsgom phyir bshad kyis nyon/ /gdod ma'i 'od gsal mkha' la snang ba'i chos/ / lhun grub yon tan grong khyer brgyan pa zhig /thog ma tha ma dbus mtha' med 'dir gnas/ /de nyid ngang las ma rig sems kyi mkhar/ /gzung 'dzin las byung 'gro drug dri za'i grong*/ /rten gzhi med la snang ba sna tshogs gzugs/ /bag chags 'khrul pa'i yid las skyes can no/ /gang 'di rtogs na sems nyid gdod ma'i ngang*/ /ma rtogs dus na da lta 'khrul pa'i sems/ / ci 'dra ngos gzung med pa dri za'i grong*/ /nyid las gzhan pa'i dpe zhig gang yin kye/ /'on kyang 'di kun rang bzhin med pa ste/ /nub kha'i thang la dri za'i grong khyer bzhin/ /rten dang brten pa gnyis ka 'khrul pa'i sems/ /bag chags nyid de brtags na ngo bo med/ /rangabazhin bzhag na ji bzhin ngang gis grol/ /de bas snying yang 'jigs spong dka' ba med/ srid 'gro ye stong dag pa'i tshul shes bya/ /yul rnams thams cad bden stong dri za'i grong*/ /blo rnams thams cad babs stong dri za'i grong*/ /yul sems gnyis stong dri za'i grong 'dra bas/ /cungazad tsam du'ang zhen 'dzin rang sar zhog /de ci med la snang ba'i chos rnams la/ /blo yis ma bzo ched dkar gzungabar shol/ / thog med 'khrul pa'ang 'dzin zhen las byung bas/ /da ni 'dzin med rangabazhin shes par bya/ /'phags pa zag pa med dang chos rnams dang*/ mya ngan 'das pa rab zhi dngos med pas/ khyod kyi dngos dang dngos po med rnams dang/ /bden stong dri za'i grong dang mkha' dbyings bzhin/ /gdod nas rab zhi skye med mkhyen pa mdzod/ /'dod chags mi dmigs de bzhin zhe sdang dang*/ / gti mug nga rgyal phra dog mi dmigs te/

/kun tu rtog can dri za'i grong 'dra bar/ /mkhyen nas nyon mongs ngo bo med can dang*/ /sems nyid byang chub gnyis su med pa'i chos/ /mkha' mnyam dri ma med par rtogs 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin gzod nas mya ngan 'das/ /'khrul rtog rab zhi mkha' la sprin dengs bzhin/ /dang po'i byung sar zhi ba'i tshul mkhyen nas/ /ye shes rab zhi stong gsal ngang der skyongs/ /skye med ngang la bsam yul mi dmigs kyang*/ /skye ba'i cho 'phrul dbyings su ma zhi bar/ /kun rtog 'khrul pa'i rtsa ba bcad par mdzod/ /bya dang mi bya blang dor gnyis med kyang/ /dngos po bdag tu 'dzin pa'i sems yod par/ /nyon mongs gnyen por zab mo'i chos bsten 'tshal/ /phyi nang gnyis med sems nyid ngang du grol/ /de ltar rtogs na mkhas pa'i skye bo yin/ /da ni de nyid don la bsgom pa yang*/ /sngon 'gro sngar bzhin dngos gzhi chos rnams kun/ /dri za'i grong du nges par 'tshal bar bya/ /gzugs ni snang ba'i stong ste dri za'i grong*/ /sgra dri ro reg chos drug dri za'i grong*/ /sems dang dgag sgrub kun rtogs shar ro cog /dri za'i grong yin ngang der gsal bar bsgom/ /cir snang thams cad dri za'i grong khyer du/ /nyin mtshan dus kun sngar bzhin goms par bya/ /dri za'i grong dang 'dus byas 'drar mthong nas/ /bden med ngang der bzhag pa'i spros kun zhi/ /stong gsal rang byung 'od gsal khong nas 'char/ /rmi lam na yang dri za'i grong du mthong*/ /sprul bsgyur la sogs sngar bzhin goms pa ste/ /bden zhen grol bas gzung 'dzin 'ching ba chad/ /kun sbyor bag chags rab zhi grol ba thob/ /de phyir dri za'i grong khyer nyid sgom shig / rdzogs pa chen po sgyu ma ngal gso las/ /dri za'i grong khyer lta bu'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// // gang 'dir rgyal bas chos kun sprul pa zhes/ /gsung pa de yang ji bzhin bshad kyis nyon/

/rang bzhin gdod nas 'od gsal ngang nyid las/ / ma rig bdag tu 'dzin pa las sprul pa'i/ /'khor ba'i 'khrul snang sna tshogs sprul pa bzhin/ /med bzhin snang la bde sdug so sor spyod/ /'di ni 'gro sems rang snang bag chags te/ /de nyid dag tshe rgyal ba sku gsum zhing/ /'od gsal ye shes rang snang rang shar bas/ /sems dang ye shes rang snang rnam gnyis su/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i lung las gsung de bzhin/ /gdod ma'i dbyings ni kun gyi 'byung gnas te/ /rig pas dri ma dag tshe ye shes dang*/ / ma rig bdag 'dzin 'khrul pas sems snang du/ /'gro drug bde sdug sprul pa lta bur snang*/ /ji ltar sprul pa gzhi med las byung ba/ /de ltar 'khrul snang gzhi med dag par shes/ /ji ltar sprul pa sems la dbang bsgyur ltar/ /de bzhin sna tshogs 'gro sems goms par shes/ /ji ltar sprul pa der snang gang 'dod pa/ /de ltar chos kun rgyu rkyen dag las shes/ /ji ltar sprul pa med snang 'khrul pa ltar/ /de bzhin chos kun med snang 'khrul pa'i blo/ /rang snang rang shar rang sems rab 'jug dbang*/ /de ltar goms pa de ltar snang ba yin/ /gang yang ma goms ji bzhin nyid bzhag na/ /gang du'ang mi 'khrul rang bzhin gzhi la gnas/ /sngon bzhin sems nyid dbyings su 'ub chub bo/ /dug gsum dug lnga kun rtog las byung ba/ /kun tu dpyad na kun tu'ang mi gnas pas/ /nyon mongs sprul 'dra ngo bo med pas na/ /ma skyes stong pa'i ngang der ji bzhin zhog /snang srid snod bcud skye 'gro ji snyed kyi/ /lus dang longs spyod 'gro 'dug bde sdug kun/ /med snang sprul pa dang 'dra rang bzhin med/ /skye med 'gag med 'ong med 'gro ba med/ /'pho med 'gyur med 'on kyang sna tshogs snang/ /de bas sprul pa dngos zhes rtogs par bya/ / sems kyi 'khrul rtog zug rngu ji snyed pa/ /de kun sprul pa lta bu'i ngang can

de/ /rang bzhin med la snang ba ma 'gags pa/ /bden stong gnyis su med ces rtogs par bya/ /'byung lnga snod dang srid gsum bcud dang ni/ /dgag sgrub ma lus sems kyi sprul pa ste/ /sems kyang med snang sgyu ma'i sprul pa ru/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag par rtogs par bya/ /mi shes byis pas brtags na legs par snang/ /blos bkod dngos po mtshan ma'i chos rnams kun/ /bag chags nyid las don du grub pa med/ /de bas 'di zhes gzung 'dzin ma byed par/ /thams cad mtha' grol brjod 'das shes par bya/ / chos kun 'di zhes brjod cing mtshon byed kyang*/ /nam mkha'i ming dang ri bong rwa 'dra bar/ /dngos med gshis la ma grub brtags pa tsam/ /ye stong rtsa ba bral bar shes par bya/ /rtog pas brtags pa blo yin don la med/ /don du snang 'di bag chags med snang yin/ /yul med yul 'dzin med pas gzung 'dzin med/ /smra med bsam med brjod med mtha' las 'das/ /don las 'di zhes sus kyang mtshon med pas/ /ye nas bdag med sprul pa lta bur shes/ /ji ltar sprul pa snang ba'i dus nas stong*/ /de ltar chos kun gang snang bden pa'i stong/ /ji ltar sprul pa yod med mtha' las 'das/ /de ltar chos kun rang bzhin dmigs bsam 'das/ /snang mod stong mod bden mod rdzun yin mod/ /gang ltar brtags kyang bden pa 'ga' med pas/ /'di zhes ma 'dzin phyogs yan chen por ltos/ /'dzin zhen med na gang yin yin du chug /tshig tsam mtshon la dgag sgrub ci byar yod/ /'di zhes 'dzin na gang yang gnas lugs min/ /yid dpyod rtog pa'i dra bas ci zhig mtshon/ / sems kyis brtags pa rang gi rtog pa ste/ /de yis don dam stong nyid mtshon byas kyang*/ /mthar 'dzin nyid las gnas lugs ga la yin/ /'on kyang mtshon te shes par byed ce na*/ /mtshan mtshon 'das la ci zhig mtshon du yod/ /de bas don med rtsod pa'i 'dzin zhen gyis/

/sems nyid mi rtogs yid dpyod pho tshod tsam/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs gang gi snying zhugs pa/ /sprin bral mkha' la nyi shar dag pa bzhin/ /nam zhig nus ldan rten 'brel thabs kyis 'char/ /de tshe dam pa'i don de mngon du 'gyur/ /thams cad phyam gcig yin min dpyad ra med/ /mkha' mnyam 'tha' grol rang stong zang ka ma/ /yangs la snang stong sprul pa'i rang bzhin du/ /chos rnams thams cad ngang gis rtogs par 'gyur/ /'khor ba gang yin 'khrul rtog sems 'di nyid/ /rtogs par gyur na ye yin mya ngan 'das/ /'dzin med rig pa'i ye shes yul la 'phyo/ /gang snang dngos la der 'dzin mi 'jug par/ /snang sems sprul pa'i ngang der blo bde rnyed/ /'di ltar rtogs nas bden mthong ye shes pa/ /gzhan zhig mtshon du med de de ring nyid/ /rang shar rang sar grol ba'i chos nyid do/ /thabs stobs bla ma'i byin rlabs snying zhugs pa/ / gang la mngon du gyur yang gzhan du min/ /mig ldan gzugs snang sgron me 'bar gyur pa/ /dmus long dag la bstan pas mthong ngam ci/ /tshig kyang mi shes don yang mi go ba/ /gang gi legs pa'i nyi ma mi mthong ba/ /de bas blon po'i skye bo gzhan dag ni/ /ne tso'i 'don pa 'dra zhing rlom pa'i khengs/ /rtog pa'i dra bas snying po'i don ma mjal/ /de nyid mi shes dmus long gzugs mjal 'dra/ /rtog pa'i dus med yid dpyod bden par 'dzin/ /e ma gzu lums shin tu skal ba ngan/ /snying po'i don la nam yang ma re zhig /'dir ni sems nyid dam pa'i ye shes ni/ /bla mas bstan pa rang rig ye shes dngos/ /rang sems bcos bslad med pa bzhag na 'char/ /re dogs 'dzin zhen med na mngon pa ste/ /stong gsal mtha' dbus med na legs kyang mngon/ /de bas brgyud pa'i byin rlabs dang ldan pa/ /dam pa'i bla mas zin pa mchog tu gces/ /gnas lugs don la yengs med bsgoms pa yang*/ /sngon 'gro sngar bzhin bla ma'i rnal 'byor la/

/sprul pa 'byong bar gsol gdab dngos gzhi ni/ /sems ni sprul pa lta bu'i rang bzhin la/ / sems la snang 'di'ang rang bzhin sprul pa 'dra/ /thams cad ma skyes sprul 'drar thag bcad nas/ /sems nyid dran bsam tshol khro bral bar gzhag /de tshe stong gsal spros pa dang bral ba'i/ /ngang la gnas pas g.yo byed gzung 'dzin bral/ /dngas gsal sprul pa lta bu'i 'od gsal 'char/ /snang yul ma 'gag der 'dzin bcos bslad med/ /sal le sang nge ma yengs ngang gis bde/ /gsal la mi rtog nam mkha' lta bu'i sems/ /rang bzhin spros dang bral ba'i nam mkha' mthong*/ /de tshe chos rnams sprul pa lta bu la/ /blo yi rnam pa'ang sprul pa lta bur grol/ /chags sdang re dogs bdag 'dzin sprul pa bzhin/ /gzhi grol lam grol 'bras bu grol ba yin/ /gang ltar bsgoms kyang de yi mi 'ching ste/ /yod par bsgoms kyang rtag pa'i mtha' las grol/ / med par bsgoms kyang chad pa'i dri ma bral/ /gnyis su bsgoms kyang gnyis med ngang der gnas/ /bdag tu bsgoms kyang bdag 'dzin 'ching ba med/ / gzhan du bsgoms kyang re dogs gnyis bcas med/ /bskyed par bsgoms kyang rdzogs par lhun grub cing/ /rdzogs rim bsgoms kyang sprul pa'i bskyed rim 'grub/ /shar grol dus mnyam nyon mongs kun las grol/ /'dzin rtog las 'das rnal ma'i ngang nyid do/ /dusagasum dus med chos nyid 'khor lo la/ /thun mtshams ris med sprul pa lta bur spyod/ /gtad med smyon pa 'dzin med zang ka ma/ /shugs 'byung rang ka re dogs bcos bslad med/ /gang yin kun yin gtad med phyam gcig pas/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams dgongs par lhun gyis grub/ /de tshe nyin mtshan sprul pa'i ngang gnas pas/ / bde chen 'khor lor bde klong gcig tu 'khyil/ /longs spyod 'khor lor rnam kun longs spyod rdzogs/ /chos kyi 'khor lor chos nyid rgyun chad med/ / sprul pa'i 'khor lor rnam 'phrul dpag tu med/

/bde skyong 'khor lor nyin mtshan bde bas gang*/ /ma sbyang bzhin du rlung sems gnad du tshud/ /sbyang gzhi sbyang bya sbyong byed rtsa 'dab rlung*/ /ye shes ro gcig sbyangs 'bras mngon du gyur/ /rmi lam sprul bsgyur zhing khams mthong ba dang*/ /phyis nas 'khrul pa'i rmi lam rgyun chad de/ /'od gsal ba la nyin dang mtshan mo gnas/ /bde gsal mi rtog ting 'dzin ngang gnas shing*/ /spyan dang mngon shes rdzun 'phrul yon tan 'grub/ /nyams rtogs tshad med rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub/ /de phyir chos kun sprul pa'i rang bzhin du/ /skal bzang rnams kyis yang dang yang sgoms shig /rdzogs pa chen po sgyu ma ngal gso las/ /sprul pa lta bu'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// // de ltar rgyal bas ji snyed bstan pa'i chos/ /sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad nyid du reg bya'i phyir/ /rgyud lung man ngag snying po'i bcud bsdus te/ /dri med 'od zair shar ba'i snang bar byas/ /dge ba de yis ma lus 'gro ba kun/ /chos rnams ma skyes sgyu ma'i tshul mthong nas/ /gong nas gong du legs pa'i chos bsgrubs te/ /rgyal ba'i sku gsum 'byor pas mdzes par shog /rmin lam sgyu ma smig rgyu gzugs brnyan dang/ /brag ca sprul pa lta bu'i chos rnams la/ / bden par zhen pa'i blo ni rab spangs te/ /ye shes yon tan gdod ma'i sar phyin shog /byis pa 'du 'dzi'i grong dang nyon mongs kyis/ /yongs gang srid pa'i nags khrod thibs po las/ /rgyang ring 'phags pa'i dga' tshal der song ste/ /dpag med lha brgya'i gtsug na mdzes gyur cig /bdag gi sems 'di rnam g.yeng la skyo bas/ /zhi ba'i nags nang dben pa'i nyams dga' bar/ /gcig pur zab mo'i de nyid rnam bsgom zhing/ /'phags pa'i blo mig yang dag thob par shog /nags rnams me tog lo ma 'bras mang zhing*/ /chu gtsang dka' thub dpal gyis brgyan pa der/ /dal 'byor snying por ldan pa'i lus 'di yis/

/don chen chos mdzod thar lam bgrod par shog /deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod bya'i phyir/ /mi yi srid par dge ba'i chos spyad de/ / zhi ba'i lam ldan yon tan tshogs mang bas/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba srid las sgrol bar shog /tshul 'di zab mo'i chos kyi snying po ste/ /nges don gnad du sgril ba'i gnad yin pas/ /thar pa 'dod pas snying nas brtson bya zhing*/ / nyin mtshan mi dal 'bad pas nyams su blang/ /phyi rabs skal ldan dad dang ldan pa kun/ /yi ge 'di la rtag tu nan tan mdzod/ /rang gzhan srid pa'i rgya mtsho rab brgal nas/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis lhun gyis grub par nges/ /mdo dang rgyud don man ngag snying po'i don/ /ma lus zab mo'i mig ldan rnal 'byor pa/ /dri med 'od zer snang bas brgyan pa des/ /gangs ri thod dkar mgul du legs par bkod/ /chos tshul nyi ma dri med 'od stong ldan/ /ye shes snang ldan ma rig mun gsal gyis/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho rab tu skems byas nas/ /thar gling snang ba phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /rdzogs pa chen po sgyu ma ngal gso zhes bya ba dpal o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma'i zhabs rten la nye bar reg pa'i rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du bkod pa rdzogs so// //dge'o/ /dge'o*/ /dge'o//
